description: This file defines the Jit class extending JsChart, responsible for generating chart resources and rendering charts within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for retrieving JavaScript resources and rendering chart HTML templates.

classes.name: Jit
classes.description: A class extending JsChart that manages chart rendering, resource inclusion, and integration within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM dashboards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that invokes the parent JsChart constructor.

methods.name: getChartResources
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for including necessary JavaScript files for chart rendering.

methods.name: getMySugarChartResources
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for including additional JavaScript files specific to sugar charts.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart using a specified template after performing parent display logic.

methods.name: getDashletScript
methods.description: Fetches and returns the script required for dashlet chart rendering.
